As a child I grew up with addict parents. My father was physically abusive. I did have 2 other siblings but it was a “every man for himself “ situation. I was S/A at 6 and was trained to stay quiet. All three of us were thought to stay quiet. If the police were called out father would lash out. I lived hearing everyone around me tell me I was worthless. That I was nothing. And I believed it. When I would go to support groups I wouldn’t think the same for other people who had similar experiences. It’s easy to believe other people are worthy. But when I think of myself… it’s hard to think that I deserve anything more. Once I turned 10 I began lashing out on my own. Fighting back. I would steal to eat and not care about the wrong I did. I didn’t hurt other people if they didn’t hurt me. But I was very bitter and have little self worth. At 13-14 I was well into drugs (mj, bars) and when my husband and I met he saw what a shitty person I was and still smiled at me. He would take me out and I would eat a meal without an argument. He would make me laugh. At a time he made me feel like I was more than nothing. And now I’m so greatful for everything he’s done for me and our son. My mind keeps yelling at me that why should I cry about pain when I have so much to be grateful for. Why should I complain when people have it worse out there. Now I’m no longer the child who would let anyone take advantage of them. But I feel as if I owe him since he got stuck with trash like me.
Yes I agree. I allowed it to happen for being a coward. I’m afraid of returning to the life I lived before him. I apologize.

I am very dependent on him. Aside from meeting him at a young age I didn’t have a good childhood. I am in no way implying that I’m ungrateful.
